lines.text: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Passover, and when Jesus was twelve they went again.
Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, and His parents traveled a day before looking among the priests and Levites.
After seven days they found Jesus in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening and asking questions.
His mother said they had searched anxiously, and Jesus said He had to be in His Father's house.
Jesus went down to Nazareth, was obedient to them, and grew in wisdom, stature, and favor with God and man.
